last_month_return.description: Annualized return of the vault over the last 30 days, in percentage, i.e. 0.1 means 10%

max_drawdown.description: Max all time drawdown realized by the vault, as a positive magnitude in percentage, i.e. 0.1 means a 10% fall

max_drawdown_24h.description: Max drawdown realized by the vault in the last 24 hours, as a positive magnitude in percentage, i.e. 0.1 means a 10% fall

max_drawdown_30d.description: Max drawdown realized by the vault in the last 30 days, as a positive magnitude in percentage, i.e. 0.1 means a 10% fall

max_drawdown_7d.description: Max drawdown realized by the vault in the last 7 days, as a positive magnitude in percentage, i.e. 0.1 means a 10% fall

net_deposits.description: Net deposits of the vault in USDC

next_fee_settlement_at.description: Estimated time of the vault's next profit-share fee settlement, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Null when the next settlement time is not yet known.

num_depositors.description: Number of depositors on the vault

owner_equity.description: Vault equity of the owner (% of ownership) in percentage, i.e. 0.1 means 10%

pnl_24h.description: P&L of the vault in the last 24 hours in USDC

pnl_30d.description: P&L of the vault in the last 30 days in USDC

pnl_7d.description: P&L of the vault in the last 7 days in USDC

profit_share_period.description: How often THIS vault settles profit-share fees, in seconds. Falls back to the exchange-wide default when the vault carries none of its own; 0 means not configured

roi_24h.description: Return of the vault in the last 24 hours in percentage, i.e. 0.1 means 10%

roi_30d.description: Return of the vault in the last 30 days in percentage, i.e. 0.1 means 10%

roi_7d.description: Return of the vault in the last 7 days in percentage, i.e. 0.1 means 10%

strategies.description: Profit-share terms and performance index for each of the vault's strategies

total_pnl.description: Total P&L of the vault in USDC

total_roi.description: Total ROI of the vault in percentage, i.e. 0.1 means 10%

tvl.description: Total Value Locked (deposits + unrealized PnL) in USDC

volume.description: All time volume traded by the vault in USD

volume_24h.description: Volume traded by the vault in the last 24 hours in USD

volume_30d.description: Volume traded by the vault in the last 30 days in USD

volume_7d.description: Volume traded by the vault in the last 7 days in USD

vtoken_price.description: Current value of vault token price in USD

vtoken_supply.description: Total amount of available vault tokens

fee_recipient.description: Address that receives this strategy's profit-share fees. Set per strategy and need not match the strategy address. Empty when no recipient is set.

pnl_index.description: Latest performance index recorded for this strategy

profit_share_percentage.description: Profit share percentage agreed for this strategy, i.e. 10 means 10%. 0 for a strategy that predates per-strategy profit share, which charges nothing. Empty when terms exist but the rate has not been seen, in which case the charged rate is unknown.
